name: 238. Virtual key metadata snapshotted onto logs (PR #7936) (vk-metadata-logs)
description: PR #7936 stamps the resolved virtual key's metadata on the request context (governance) and merges it into the log row's metadata (logging), after every request-supplied source, so spend is filterable by the key's attribution with the existing /api/logs?metadata_<key>=<value> filter and a caller cannot override it: on a key collision the virtual key's value beats an x-bf-lh-* header and an x-bf-dim-* dimension of the same name, while unrelated caller labels are kept. One self-contained row, like the session-affinity management cases: the pre-request script creates a key with openai access whose cost_center carries the run id; the chat request goes through it carrying x-bf-lh-cost_center and x-bf-dim-owner spoofs plus an unrelated x-bf-lh-tenant label; the test script filters the logs on the key's cost_center (polling, since the log writer batches), expects exactly that request, reads the row and checks cost_center and owner come from the key and tenant from the header, then deletes the key and the log row. One row is deliberate: the recipe forks newman per provider and modality class, so setup in a separate management row would be pulled into the chat shard as a producer and run twice. Red before the change: the row carries the spoofed cost_center, so the filter on the key's value finds nothing. The row only ever deletes the key it created in this run; nothing sweeps by age, so a parallel shard's key is never touched. A key left by an aborted run is named harness-vk-metadata-logs-run-<ms>-<rand> for manual cleanup. The pure merge rules, the MCP and passthrough stamping paths and the realtime handlers are covered by Go tests (TestMergeVirtualKeyMetadata, TestPostLLMHookSnapshotsVirtualKeyMetadata, TestPreMCPConnectionHook_StampsVirtualKeyMetadata, TestRealtimeContextsCarryVirtualKeyMetadata).
